fact: FAO's GIEWS country brief for Guinea-Bissau says satellite-based data showed some dry spells affected crops in localized areas in 2025, and lists GIEWS Earth Observation for Crop Monitoring among the tools used to prepare it.
system: FAO/GIEWS Earth Observation for Crop Monitoring

fact: WFP Guinea-Bissau says it carries out monthly monitoring of rainy-season conditions, using CHIRPS rainfall, MODIS NDVI and land surface temperature processed in Google Earth Engine, to report vegetation state and flood risk for agriculture.
system: Bulletin de suivi de la saison pluvieuse
